_what_this_is: A hand-authored policy prior for managing a concentrated institutional equity book. It was written by a person reading public evidence, NOT produced by the Nuwa distillation pipeline. Every parameter carries provenance='derived' or 'house_default' rather than 'direct', because Berkshire has never published a single-name cap as a number. Treating a reader's inference as a published threshold would be the exact overclaim this project keeps refusing to make.
_why_not_the_buffett_advisor: backend/app/advisors/builtin/buffett is a household-advice persona: index funds, emergency funds, staying out of things you do not understand. This artifact is about running a concentrated equity book, which is a different job with different numbers. Loading the household persona here would produce a 5% single-name cap and trim away the entire thesis.
_contamination: UPPER BOUND, not a measurement. Whoever authored these numbers already knows what Berkshire did after 2014, and no instruction makes that knowledge go away. These parameters therefore bound what a faithful distillation could contribute; they do not measure it. Any forward result produced with this policy is a demonstration that the pipeline runs, never evidence that the philosophy predicts.
_evidence_window: Authored from material published on or before 2014-12-31, so that the frozen FinanceNuwa episodes from 2014 onward remain usable as a held-out comparison. The citations below are all pre-window.

single_name_concentration.name: single_name_concentration
source_labels: Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter 1993 — on concentration and the meaning of risk
Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter 1996 — on owning a few understandable businesses
single_name_concentration.note: Read from behaviour, not from a published rule. Berkshire has repeatedly run single positions well above any conventional cap, so the direction ('higher than a default') is far better evidenced than the level. The wide low/high band is the honest expression of that.

top3_concentration.name: top3_concentration
source_labels: Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter 1993 — on concentration and the meaning of risk
top3_concentration.note: Even weaker than the single-name figure. Carried mainly so the direction is on record.

_scope_note: Concentration only. This artifact says nothing about debt, liquidity, or allocation for a household, and the empty scopes are what stop it being consulted on questions it has no business answering.

stance_rules._how_to_read: Deterministic mapping from a position's weight to a stance. Thresholds are expressed relative to the single-name cap above, so changing the cap moves these together rather than leaving them inconsistent.
